description: Bring-your-own-database: move where this app stores its players' data (saves, rooms, community) from Neblla's default store to the developer's own database. Actions: "status" (current engine + migration progress); "validate" (engine + config, tests the connection, changes nothing); "migrate" (validates again, then starts a 3-phase background migration of ALL player data — confirm with the developer first); "cancel" (only before the last phase). Engines and config: mongo {uri, dbName}, turso {url, authToken}, postgres {uri}, mysql {uri}. Credentials are stored encrypted and never returned.

config.description: For validate / migrate: the connection settings of the engine

name: neblla_byodb
